  - Get me a bumpy oval fruit that tastes sour!
  - Get me a yellow fruit that tastes very sour!

Do this for ALL 10 target objects listed below (100 questions in total — exactly 10 per target):

  2. tomato
  3. apple
  4. banana
  5. carrot
  6. grape
  7. corn
  8. cookie
  9. dinosaur
  10. cup
